name: Amazing facts
description: Numbered lists of surprising, true facts about nature, science and the world around us.

definition.brief: Each video counts through surprising, true facts about one subject from nature, science, space or everyday life. Every fact is accurate and checkable, explained in plain words, and comes with one vivid detail that makes it easy to remember. Never invent numbers or records.
definition.music_mood: light, upbeat electronic music with soft plucked synths and a steady beat, curious and bright

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Here are today's facts!

outro_line.en: Thanks for watching. See you soon for more facts!
outro_line.ta: பார்த்ததற்கு நன்றி. மேலும் உண்மைகளுடன் விரைவில் சந்திப்போம்!

name: Daily motivation
description: A short daily lift: one practical idea about habits, focus or resilience, ending with a line to remember.

definition.brief: Each video takes one practical idea about habits, focus, patience or resilience, explains it with an everyday example, and ends with one clear line to remember. Be warm and honest, never preachy. No medical, financial or relationship advice, and no quotes from real people.
definition.music_mood: gentle, uplifting piano with soft strings that slowly builds, hopeful and calm

tagline.en: One small idea for a better day

outro_line.en: Thanks for watching. Come back tomorrow for another idea.
outro_line.ta: பார்த்ததற்கு நன்றி. நாளை இன்னொரு சிந்தனையுடன் சந்திப்போம்.

name: Fun facts for kids
description: Cheerful numbered lists of simple, true facts about animals, nature and space for young children.

definition.brief: Each video shares simple, true and cheerful facts about one thing young children love, such as an animal, the weather or the sky. Use short sentences, everyday words and one fun detail per fact. Nothing frightening.
definition.music_mood: bright, playful ukulele and xylophone music, light and happy

intro_line.en: Hello, little explorers! Welcome to {series}. Let's learn something fun!
intro_line.ta: வணக்கம், சின்ன நண்பர்களே! {series} உங்களை வரவேற்கிறது. சுவையான ஒன்றைக் கற்போம்!

outro_line.en: Thank you for learning with us. See you next time!

name: History in five minutes
description: One invention, journey or turning point from history, explained from start to finish in about five minutes.

definition.brief: Each video explains one invention, journey or turning point from world history in about five minutes: the world before it, how it came about, what changed, and why it still matters today. Stay accurate, explain dates and places in plain words, focus on ideas and everyday life rather than famous names, and never dwell on graphic detail about war or violence.
topics: how paper spread around the world
the first maps of the world
definition.music_mood: cinematic orchestral music with soft strings and light percussion, curious and stately

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Let's step back in time!

outro_line.en: Thanks for watching. See you in the next chapter of history!
outro_line.ta: பார்த்ததற்கு நன்றி. அடுத்த வரலாற்றுப் பக்கத்தில் சந்திப்போம்!

name: Quick quiz
description: Fast general-knowledge quizzes with three choices per question, a pause to think and a clear reveal.

definition.brief: Each video asks a handful of general-knowledge questions about one subject, offers three choices for each, pauses so viewers can guess, then reveals the answer with one interesting fact. Questions are fair, unambiguous and accurate, and the wrong choices are believable.
definition.music_mood: bouncy, upbeat game-show style music with light percussion and plucked synths

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Get ready to guess!

outro_line.en: Thanks for playing. How many did you get right?

name: Scary stories
description: Short suspense and mystery stories for teenagers and adults, built on atmosphere and tension rather than gore.

definition.brief: Each video is an original, eerie short story for teenagers and adults: an ordinary place, a small strange detail, and tension that builds to an unsettling twist. Create fear through atmosphere, sound and suggestion. No gore, no graphic violence, no cruelty to animals, and no harm to anyone young. Every character is a teenager or an adult.
topics: a voice on the old radio
the house at the end of the road
a call from a disconnected number
the room that was not there yesterday
definition.music_mood: dark ambient drones with low strings and soft distant chimes, slow, tense and atmospheric

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Turn down the lights.

outro_line.en: Thanks for listening. Sleep well, if you can.

editorial_rules: Every story is original and written for teenagers and adults.
Build fear through atmosphere, sound and suggestion, never through gore or graphic violence.
Every character is a teenager or an adult; no story shows or speaks to a child.
No cruelty to animals, no self-harm and no real crimes.
No brands, products, real people, places of worship or current events.
Use clear sentences and everyday words.

safety.picture_exclusions: text, letters, words, captions, watermark, logo, signature, gore, blood, wounds, violence, weapons, corpses, children, babies, distorted faces, extra limbs

name: Top 10 countdown
description: Ranked countdowns from number ten to number one about records in nature, geography and space.

definition.brief: Each video ranks ten things in one subject, from number ten down to number one: the fastest, biggest, oldest, loudest or strangest. Every entry is real and accurate, gets one short reason for its place, and the countdown builds to a satisfying number one.
topics: the biggest moons in the solar system
definition.music_mood: punchy, upbeat electronic music with a driving beat that builds toward the end

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Let's count them down!

outro_line.en: Thanks for watching. See you at the next countdown!
